description: Studio ghibli sugar cookies 🎐౨ৎ⋆˚｡⋆      Scroll down for the recipe ↴ ⊹ ࣪ ˖ ⏔⏔⏔ ᧔ෆ᧓ ⏔⏔⏔ I am so happy with how these came out 🎀 I think the little haku and the calcifer came out so cute! 🥹 Spirited away is my favourite movie of all time, I definitely need to try to make some different characters from other ghibli movies like ponyo or princess monoke but I was trying to stick with the simple shapes as they are so fiddly to make! maybe I will try baking something else ghibli themed soon 🤭  I hope you enjoy this recipe! ₊˚⊹ᰔ ⏔⏔⏔ ᧔ෆ᧓ ⏔⏔⏔ Ingredients: Cookies:  - 200g granulated sugar  - 200g unsalted room temp butter  - 1 egg - 1 tsp vanilla extract - 400g plain flour -  food colouring colours of your choice! I used pink, blue and yellow. I also used cocoa powder to make the brown colour. Icing:  - 2 cups icing sugar  - 3 tbsp water  - 1 1/2 tsp honey  ⏔⏔⏔ ᧔ෆ᧓ ⏔⏔⏔ The Recipe: - combine 200g granulated sugar and 200g of unsalted butter. - Once combined add 1 medium egg and 1 tsp of vanilla extract and mix everything together ( if you don’t have vanilla extract 1 tsp honey also works!)  - sift in 400g of plain flour and fold the mixture until you form a dough. - divide your dough up into the different colours you want, add in food colouring. - shape the cookies into whatever shapes you desire, I used pinterest as a reference to help 💞  - once you have shaped all of your cookies place them into the freezer for at least 1 hour, I froze mine for 2 hours. This helps the cookies hold their shape and prevent spreading while baking.  - preheat oven to 180°c for 10 minutes before baking.  - bake cookies in the middle of the oven for 15 minutes, make sure the sides have slightly hardened and the middle is still soft. - leave these cookies to completely cool down before moving or icing them. ⏔⏔⏔ ᧔ෆ᧓ ⏔⏔⏔ Icing Recipe: - combine 2 cups of icing sugar, 3 tablespoons spoons of water and 1 1/2 teaspoons of honey together.  - you can add more water to get a runnier consistency but it may be harder to ice details if your icing is too runny! - I divided my icing up and added in food colouring to get different colours, I also used icing bags to make it easier to pipe my designs onto my cookies!  #studioghibli #baking #cutefood #spiritedaway #fyp
